name: Lavorvomon
main_effect: [On Play] Reveal the top 4 cards of your deck. Add 1 Digimon card with the [Rock Dragon], [Earth Dragon], [Bird Dragon], [Machine Dragon] or [Sky Dragon] trait, and 1 [Hina Kurihara] among them to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.
source_effect: [When Attacking] While this Digimon has an [On Play] effect, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 3000 DP or less.
